title: Dragonbane Battlespear
html:
Source not yet observed

Skill needed

Wielding it takes the Spear weapon skill. No class starts with it. To learn it, finish the quest Beyond the Point (Guard Tobin Reed near Underleaf, warriors, level 10): free, and you keep the skill for good.

See Weapon skills & specials for how the skill levels and what it unlocks.

How to get it

Unique. Dropped by Lord Vorhal the Dragonbane on 2% of kills (10% from an elite). Built on Titanium Battlespear; bound, so it can’t be traded. Unique items can’t be reforged.

  • +15% damage against dragons and sand wyrms.

See Unique items for all of them.

No monster drops recorded for this item.
